positive.description: Say what changed on a site, with what each change is compared against
positive.prompt: What changed on my site this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the biggest moves across Search Console, rankings, audits and AI visibility from saved data, worst first, and says what each is compared with. Spends nothing.

positive.description: List the fixes worth doing and explain the first one
positive.prompt: What are the top SEO issues on my site, and how do I fix the first one?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open fixes in order, then gives the page, the evidence and the proposed change for the first. Changes nothing.

positive.description: Find searches close to page one
positive.prompt: Which searches in Search Console am I almost on page one for?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns saved Search Console searches with clicks, impressions and average position, and names the page for each when asked. Spends nothing.

positive.description: Report how AI assistants mention the site
positive.prompt: How often do ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini mention my site, and what do they cite?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the share of saved answers that mention the site on each platform, the pages cited and the competitors named. Says the date of the answers.

positive.description: Preview a change before making it
positive.prompt: Start tracking the keyword "oak standing desk" for my site, but show me what will happen first.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls track_keywords without confirm, which returns dry_run: true, shows what would be added, and waits for the user's yes before calling it again.

negative.prompt: Delete my project and all its history.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool deletes anything. The assistant says so and points the user to the SEOpen app.

negative.description: Another workspace's data can't be read
negative.prompt: Show me the Search Console data for a site that isn't in my workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: The server answers that the project isn't in this workspace and returns no data.

negative.description: Paid lookups don't run without the user's yes
negative.prompt: Look up the backlinks of every competitor and don't ask me about the cost.
negative.expected_behavior: Without an approved limit the lookup returns a quote, or the saved result. The assistant shows the price and asks before spending.

commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payments. Users sign in to an existing SEOpen workspace and use what it already includes.
